source_refresh.method: Rounded midpoint of the unchanged battery gap after source-atlas regeneration; the higher cutoff tightens retrieval.

note: A find whose best BM25 score is below the floor returns no items with reason below_floor. The floor lies in the gap between the highest negative and the lowest positive best score. Single-term queries score about 7.8 to 9.0 and may fall below the floor; a phrase is expected.
